description: This file contains JavaScript code for the ISC_SQLBrowser module of the SmartClient framework, defining classes, methods, and configurations for SQL browsing and editing within the framework.

classes.name: SQLEditor
classes.description: A class representing a SQL editor component with input form, execution button, and preview grid.

classes.name: SQLTableBrowser
classes.description: A class for browsing SQL tables with preview grid and filtering capabilities.

classes.name: DBPane
classes.description: A tabbed pane for managing SQL editors and table browsers.

classes.name: DBSchema
classes.description: A data source representing database schema information.

classes.name: DBSchemaTree
classes.description: A tree grid displaying database schema details.

classes.name: DataSourceStore
classes.description: A data source for managing SQL data sources.

classes.name: DBList
classes.description: A list grid showing available databases.

classes.name: DBCompactList
classes.description: A form for selecting a database to compact.

classes.name: DBListDS
classes.description: A data source for database list information.

methods.name: initWidget
methods.description: Initializes the widget components for each class.

methods.name: execSQL
methods.description: Executes the SQL query entered in the editor.

methods.name: dsLoaded
methods.description: Handles the data source loading callback.

methods.name: showDS
methods.description: Displays the data source in a grid.

methods.name: showWindow
methods.description: Creates and shows the SQL Browser window.
